newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins major U.S. contract.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins major U.S. contract.

text.p: Swedish telecoms company Ericsson said on Thursday it signed a letter of intent with Bellsouth Mobility Inc of the U.S. to supply its D-Amps 1900 system equipment for five states.
Ericsson said the deal is worth around 1.55 billion crowns.
The systems will be installed in Bellsouth's Basic Trading Area (BTA) markets in Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana and Mississippi.
The contract calls for Ericsson to supply and install six switches and more than 500 of its RBS 884 Macro base stations throughout the states.
The technology provides mobile telephone users with advanced functions like caller identification, security services and short messaging systems.
